About Keyboard Escape Block Speed +1

Ready to test your reflexes while running across giant keyboards? Press the correct keys, increase your speed, and survive as long as possible without falling! With simple controls and fun gameplay, this adventure is easy to learn but challenging to master. Try to achieve the highest score and escape across the keyboards in this exciting challenge!
